name: dot-matrix-grid
title: Dot Matrix Grid
description: Precise geometric dot matrix background rendered via radial gradient masks with configurable pitch and radius.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Airy
Shape: Pill
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Passive Canvas Backdrop: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
